title: ithyno Skill Manifest
description: Metadata for a universal skill source under ithyno/skills/<name>/. Consumed by per-CLI renderers at install time.

name.description: Skill id in kebab-case. MUST match the directory name.

command.description: Command name within the namespace (e.g. 'apply' for /ithy-opsx:apply).

description.description: One-line description shown in each CLI's command picker.

supports.description: Set of CLIs for which a renderer will be invoked. Uninstalled CLIs are skipped at install time.

capabilities_required.description: Capability tokens the skill body uses. Renderers refuse to emit for CLIs that cannot satisfy a required capability.

per_cli.description: Per-CLI overrides. Keys are CLI ids from the `supports` set; values are renderer-specific hint objects.
